zh: 招聘页重做：支持按职能筛选和关键词搜索，卡片更清爽
AI 对话单次最多可发 9 张图片，超出限制时会明确提示
网络异常提示更友好，重试按钮不再被挤出屏幕
「一键解读」与「深度研究」暂时下线，后续以新形式回归
en: Jobs page redesigned: filter by role, search by keyword, cleaner cards
Send up to 9 images per AI chat message, with a clear message when the limit is exceeded
Friendlier network error messages, and the retry button stays on screen
One-tap summary and Deep Research are retired for now; they will return in a new form
